verify_note: npm run tools:check verifies presence and sha256 of every pinned file on the machine it runs on. It is NOT part of npm run verify: CI has none of these tools, so it would always exit 2 there. Run it locally where the tools are installed. It never downloads and never executes a tool.

exit_codes.0: every required file present and every hash matched
exit_codes.1: at least one sha256 or size mismatch (wins over missing)
exit_codes.2: at least one required file or directory missing
exit_codes.3: usage error, unreadable config or invalid manifest

roots_note: Root resolution, highest first: the root's env var, then roots{} in the JSON file named by --config or MCE_TOOLS_CONFIG, then the default above. Every file path below is relative to its root; absolute paths are refused by the checker.

file_roles.binary: the file that runs or is loaded; required
file_roles.published: the exact artefact whose sha256 the upstream project publishes; required
file_roles.archive: downloaded archive kept for provenance; optional (missing is a warning, a mismatch is still exit 1)
file_roles.config: local config the tool is run with; required
